# Lycorax MCP

> Five website audit tools for AI agents, served by Apify's hosted MCP server (no self-hosting): Shopify and WooCommerce alt text fixers, a website image SEO audit, a domain RDAP/DNS/SPF/DMARC/TLS checker, and a defensive website exposure knowledge tool. Connect with one remote MCP URL and Apify OAuth or an Apify API token. Runs are billed by Apify to the user's own Apify account.

MCP server URL (Streamable HTTP):
https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=j0l30/shopify-seo-alt-text-fixer,j0l30/woocommerce-seo-alt-text-fixer,j0l30/website-image-seo-audit,j0l30/domain-rdap-dns-reputation-checker,j0l30/website-exposure-defense-knowledge

Tool names use `--` in place of `/` (for example `j0l30--website-image-seo-audit`). A tool call returns run status and a `datasetId`; read results with `get-dataset-items`. Write-back to stores is off by default, defaults to a dry run, and requires the user's explicit authorisation.

## Tools
- [Shopify Alt Text Generator & Image SEO Auto-Fix](https://apify.com/j0l30/shopify-seo-alt-text-fixer): audit Shopify product image alt text and page SEO basics; optional Admin API write-back with dry run and rollback
- [WooCommerce Alt Text Generator & Image SEO Fixer](https://apify.com/j0l30/woocommerce-seo-alt-text-fixer): same for WooCommerce and WordPress media; optional REST API write-back with dry run and rollback
- [Image SEO Checker & Alt Text Checker for Any Website](https://apify.com/j0l30/website-image-seo-audit): crawl any site for alt text, image weight/format, width/height and lazy-loading issues; before/after proof and Cloudflare Worker fixes
- [Domain Reputation Checker: Bulk RDAP, DMARC & DNS Lookup](https://apify.com/j0l30/domain-rdap-dns-reputation-checker): RDAP, DNS, SPF, DMARC, TLS, HTTPS and security headers for up to 1,000 domains; check, monitor and availability modes
- [Website Exposure Defense Knowledge for AI Agents](https://apify.com/j0l30/website-exposure-defense-knowledge): defensive guidance for site owners fixing indexed .env, .git, backups and other leaks on their own sites
